description: Defines the RenderTargetCache template class used for caching back-end render targets in graphics back-ends like D3D9, D3D11, and Vulkan within the ANGLE project. Manages updates and retrieval of render targets associated with framebuffer attachments.

classes.name: RenderTargetCache
classes.description: A cache for back-end render targets associated with framebuffer attachments, supporting update and retrieval operations.

methods.name: RenderTargetCache()
methods.description: Constructor initializing cache pointers to null.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates all render targets based on framebuffer dirty bits.

methods.name: updateReadColorRenderTarget
methods.description: Updates the read color render target.

methods.name: updateColorRenderTarget
methods.description: Updates a specific color attachment render target.

methods.name: getColors
methods.description: Returns the array of color render targets.

methods.name: getColorDraw
methods.description: Retrieves the color render target for drawing.

methods.name: getColorRead
methods.description: Retrieves the color render target for reading.
